name: Do I need a permit for a new pool in Los Angeles County cities?

mainEntity.name: Do Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood require permits for a new luxury pool?
mainEntity.text: Do Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, or North Hollywood require permits for a new luxury pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: New luxury pool construction in Los Angeles-area cities generally requires a permit and multiple inspections. The review process usually covers site plans, structural details, plumbing, electrical work, safety barriers, and sometimes drainage or grading. Cities can differ in fee schedules, submittal requirements, and review timelines, so a project in Pasadena may not follow the same process as one in the City of Los Angeles or Glendale. Homeowners should expect to submit plans before any excavation starts and should avoid beginning work early, because unpermitted work can create delays and redesign costs. A good builder will coordinate the permit package, engineering, and inspection schedule as part of preconstruction. For hillside or custom projects, the permit path can take longer because the city may ask for revised plans or additional structural documentation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes.
